QuestInfo.name: Finding New Strength
QuestInfo.0: Haruaki in Momijigaoka has something important to tell you.
QuestInfo.1: You need to gather allies to fight Oda and his army. Scouts have found a town north of Momijigahara. Check it out.
QuestInfo.2: You encountered Kino Konoko, the leader of the Mushroom Shrine. Maybe she knows something about the situation.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 5,118\nCan proceed to the A Strange Encounter quest

0.0: Hayato, you seem to have adjusted to your new surroundings, though you look more spindly than usual. Do not neglect your training. Nobunaga will not be a pushover.
0.1: Challenging the Oda clan head-on with our army would be suicide. Nobunaga has shown an impressive knowledge of this world in his short time here. It would be like facing a day of sport with improper diet.
0.2: So, I have something to ask of you. Leave us. Go, and take in this new world. Find allies, find power. Find out what they eat to stay trim... everything is pigs and fat here. Only then will you truly be of any use in the coming battle.

yes.0: Yes! You'll find a town with inhabitants to the north of Momijigahara. The enemy has most likely created a pathway to get to it.
yes.1: You should depart as soon as possible. And do not tell the others. They will not understand.

no.0: Are you almost ready? No one here has juiced in days. I think I feel my skin flaking off!

1.0: Welcome to the Mushroom Shrine. How can I help you? Oh! Please don't step on that spot. I just swept it.

default.0: Go down the hill to the east. There's a town north of Momijigahara. It will be relatively easy to find with Oda's men tromping all about.
